The HEIC fixtures in this folder are CC0 test charts from https://heic.fyi/heic-sample-files (checked 11 October 2026).

- `basic-8bit-srgb.heic`: 1600 × 1200, SHA-256 `3fe7d32e5568f8bfd6b5d3290e61ac9b964d08464d388fa064f69cdddfee82c`.
- `orientation-6.heic`: displays at 1200 × 800 after HEIF orientation, SHA-256 `80b615ae433d7ec53e9aaaeee081ecd11c0d9931350da13d6ce4e2b363d12c12`.

The images are synthetic charts and contain no personal data.

`locked.pdf` is a blank 100 × 100 pt page encrypted with pypdf 6.19.0 for the password-error browser test.
